mission.title: Merchandise
mission.description: Follow up a report that Cryptos' boxes were stolen from a warehouse.

npc.say: Funny thing is, it never seemed to work. Hey, uh... Could I get a receipt for that?
Hey, I'm on the clock here, pudding! I've got a business to run! Go check in with Jason Xavier.
Check back any time, baby! I got some diamond-studded piercings you would kill for!
Take care of that thing, it's gonna be a collector's item some day!
That's all I've got. Not my fault! Gotta run!

phase.briefing:
Since that Neo-nutcase foiled your last little attempt to dig up some dirt on the Cypherites, we're gonna have to try it again.
We picked up a tip off the police wire recently about a guy who reported Cryptos' little Jack-in-the-Boxes as being stolen from his warehouse. Claimed that Cryptos had rented the storage space for 'em, and then one day they were just gone--nobody saw anyone take them out, and Cryptos himself never got back to the guy. The cops laughed it off, of course, but for some reason Lock thinks it sounds worth checking out. So you're going to pay a visit to the warehouse manager, name of Arnold Cheng.

enter.say: That should be Arnold Cheng's residence. I've got a bluepill signal inside.

talk.say:
You want to know about the boxes? Sure! Those cops thought I was nuts. Them boxes just went missing one night; not a soul saw them go, as far as I know, and Cryptos never said a word about it--didn't even come back to claim his deposit.
The deposit? Oh, it was a nice watch that he had on when he came in to rent the space. I've got it with me, actually--for safekeeping, you know. Uh, sure, I'd be okay with your borrowing it, if you think it would help in your investigation. I just want to do the right thing here.

done.say: Cryptos' watch? Better get it from this guy. Could come in handy.

objective.text: Get Cryptos' watch from Arnold Cheng

done.say: That is one fancy watch--so fancy that I'm scanning a jeweler's mark on the back. Jackpot. Head outside while I look up this jeweler.

phase.briefing: Haha! We stole Cryptos' watch! Oh man, that is rich. Hey, hold on to that thing, would ya? I want to wear it the next time I go slumming.

enter.say: That's the regional office of the jeweler who worked on Cryptos' watch.

talk.say: Hey baby, what can I do you for? Cryptos' watch? Yeah, I probably did that--Jeweler to the Stars, that's me! Give it here and I'll take a gander.

done.say: Sounds like you'll have to hand over the watch.

objective.text: Show Cryptos' watch to the Jeweler

talk.say:
Yep, this is my handiwork, all right. Stunning, ain't she? Damn, I'm good. Cryptos knows quality when he sees it; that's why he comes to yours truly for all his fine craftsmanship needs.
I didn't do the actual sale, though; I let the little people handle the details. Go talk to my head salesperson, Jason Xavier. He'll hook you up, chief!

done.say: Get Cryptos' watch back from that shyster before you talk to Jason Xavier, {player}! I want that watch!

talk.say: Cryptos? Doesn't ring a bell. I see a lot of people every day. You got the piece? Maybe it'll help jog something loose upstairs.

done.say: Sounds like you'll have to let him see the watch, too. And don't forget to get it back, or Anome will get extra cranky.

objective.text: Show Cryptos' watch to Jason Xavier

talk.say: I'll need to see that watch, bud. A picture's worth a thousand words, ya know?

Ohh, right, this piece. Funny request; he wanted a watch that didn't run. Weird guy, huh? Anyway, seeing as how we like to keep on the right side of the law and all around here, I can pull that customer's file for you. And...that should do it. Find my clerk, Woodrow Quigley. He'll have the printout for you.

done.say: Don't forget to get the watch back before you go find Woodrow Quigley!

objective.text: Get the printout from Woodrow Quigley

talk.say: Printout? Printout... Oh, that! I've got it right here.

done.say: Well how about that, Cryptos' home address. Want to pay him a little visit?

phase.briefing:
Hey, hey, not so fast, lightning. You owe me one Cryptos watch. Head to the marked waypoint and hand it over to my man, Abalakin.
Oh, and we have some of the General's commandos standing by there to help you when you go to arrest Cryptos; they seem to be interested in encountering Cypherites firsthand. This time I've got that cheap parlor magician right where I want him!

enter.say: That's the place. Anome sure is anxious to get that watch. I wonder if he collects stamps, too?

talk.say: This better be the real deal. Uh... You can go now.

phase.briefing: Okay now, get that guy! I don't care if you have to bomb the place, or kill his mother, or pull his fingernails out--just get Cryptos!

enter.say: That's the address we got from the Jeweler's people. I've got redpill readings inside.
More people dressed like Neo or Trinity? What is going on there?

objective.text: Kill all of the Neo fanatics

done.say: Place scans clean. No Cypherites, no Cryptos--nothing except those Neo fanatics. This is starting to become a problem.

complete.say: Agents have locked on to your position! Get out of there now!

mission.finish:
What the hell? Can't you do a simple thing right? You expect me to believe that Neo came back from the dead and stopped you from capturing Cryptos? That's pathetic! I don't want to hear your ridiculous excuses, you...you...
Bah! Why am I wasting my time with you? Anome, out.
